cues.en: People think that when I do the summarization compaction strategy, the text in Cosmos DB gets summarized or gets truncated based on which strategy you're using.
cues.zh: 有些人以為，使用摘要壓縮策略時，Cosmos DB 裡的文字也會被摘要；使用截斷策略時，資料就會被刪掉。
